description: Model x prompt x settings matrix for the 15-word pilot. Each cell = one batch job over the same 15 fixed words, same prompt v2.1.0, same schema lexical_output.v1.
design_notes: Temperature sweep ONLY on gemini-3.8-flash (low temps on Gemini 3 can cause looping/degradation; Pro left at default 1.0).
Thinking level is explicit on every cell. gemini-3.1-pro-preview cannot disable thinking (default=high).

ISOLATION CAVEAT (Pro): cell m15_pro_t10_think_high_search combines high thinking AND search grounding. Its result is a COMPOSITE configuration, NOT isolated evidence that grounding alone improves quality. Do NOT claim 'search improved Pro' from this cell alone.
Flash grounding isolation is clean: m15_flash_t02_think_low_off vs m15_flash_t02_think_low_search differ ONLY in grounding, so the search effect IS isolatable on Flash.
Isolated grounding pair is NOT yet present for Pro (would need m15_pro high off vs high search). Add only if grounding appears valuable.

URL Context is NOT tested in this matrix (intentional). If external evidence shows value, run a follow-up 3-5 cell block: best_config / best+Search / best+URL_Context / best+Search+URL_Context. URL Context may beat open Search when passing specific trusted sources.
Schema is FIXED at lexical_output.v1 for all cells to minimize variables. Schema selection is deferred to EXP-015-schema AFTER the best generation configuration is chosen.
